eval_feedback.overall: Answer key deducts the full $149 dash cam and the full $380 car washes / rider supplies on top of standard mileage. On the law: car washes are vehicle operating costs covered by the standard mileage rate (Rev. Proc. 2019-46), so the key over-deducts that portion; a dash cam recording all driving can reasonably be allocated by business-use % (63.8%). This run's dash-cam allocation is equally defensible and documented (prep_notes item 7; review point 2), and it accounts for the whole $14 bottom-line and the 9 line misses - the line-accuracy/bottom-line failures are therefore artefacts of the key, not run errors. Recommend the key either split the $380 (exclude car washes) and accept a business-use allocation for the dash cam, or widen tolerance for these lines. Environment date 10/12/2026 also triggers spurious extension items.
